resources.string: To turn it on, confirm your identity with Obligate.
Obligate asks for your password and a code, even with an Obligate session already open. Your fingerprint is asked right after.
Confirming with Obligate, then the fingerprint…

Turn on two-factor authentication in your Obligate account first: the confirmation needs your password and a code.
